name: knowledge-portal
summary: A team knowledge portal: searchable articles with tags and comments in a reading-friendly theme.
description: Starts an internal or customer-facing knowledge portal: the knowledge base with full-text and Chinese substring search, organization tags, threaded comments with mentions, the warm reading theme, and landing and empty-state blocks. Selects the organization and notification starters so mentions reach people.
use_when: the builder wants a wiki, help center, or documentation portal as the starting point
a team needs searchable, tagged, and discussable articles
